mapper.sql: sg.shop_code, sg.sitecode, sg.goodscode, sg.goodsname, sg.spec, sg.imgurl, sg.mainimgs, sg.sitecategory, sg.price, sg.moq, sg.unit, sg.featured, sg.publishstatus, sg.sortnum, sg.specsjson, sg.optionsjson, sg.siteimgs, sg.sitevideos, sg.model3d, sg.model3d_marks, sg.model3d_states, sg.mainvideo

from u_s_sitegoods sg left join u_s_sitegoods_lang l on l.shop_code = sg.shop_code and l.sitecode = sg.sitecode and l.goodscode = sg.goodscode and l.lang = #{lang} left join u_s_sitegoods_lang d on d.shop_code = sg.shop_code and d.sitecode = sg.sitecode and d.goodscode = sg.goodscode and d.lang = #{defaultLang}

where sg.sitecode = and sg.publishstatus = '已上架'
and (sg.sitecategory = #{category} or (substring(sg.sitecategory, 1, char_length(#{category})) = #{category} and substring(trim(substring(sg.sitecategory, char_length(#{category}) + 1)), 1, 1) in ('/', '／', '>', '＞')))
and (coalesce(l.title, d.title, sg.goodsname) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or coalesce(l.subtitle, d.subtitle) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sg.goodscode like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
select , coalesce(l.title, d.title, sg.goodsname) title, coalesce(l.subtitle, d.subtitle) subtitle, coalesce(l.keywords, d.keywords) keywords
order by sg.featured desc, sg.sortnum asc, sg.createtime desc, sg.goodscode asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select , coalesce(l.title, d.title, sg.goodsname) title, coalesce(l.subtitle, d.subtitle) subtitle, coalesce(l.description, d.description) description, coalesce(l.keywords, d.keywords) keywords, l.specsjson langspecsjson
where sg.sitecode = and sg.goodscode = #{goodsCode} and sg.publishstatus = '已上架' limit 1
select distinct sitecategory from u_s_sitegoods where sitecode = and publishstatus = '已上架' and sitecategory is not null and sitecategory != '' order by sitecategory
select , sg.remark, sg.createuser, sg.createtime, sg.updateuser, sg.updatetime from u_s_sitegoods sg where sg.sitecode = and sg.goodscode = #{goodsCode}
select count(*) from (select 1 from u_s_sitegoods sg where sg.sitecode = and sg.goodscode = #{goodsCode} limit 1) hit
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_sitegoods( shop_code, sitecode, goodscode, goodsname, spec, imgurl, mainimgs, sitecategory, price, moq, unit, featured, publishstatus, sortnum, specsjson, optionsjson, siteimgs, sitevideos, model3d, model3d_marks, model3d_states, mainvideo, remark, createuser, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{siteCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec}, #{imgUrl}, #{mainImgs}, #{siteCategory}, coalesce(#{price}, 0), #{moq}, #{unit}, coalesce(#{featured}, 0), coalesce(#{publishStatus}, '草稿'), coalesce(#{sortNum}, 0), #{specsJson}, #{optionsJson}, #{siteImgs}, #{siteVideos}, #{model3d}, #{model3dMarks}, #{model3dStates}, #{mainVideo}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update u_s_sitegoods set goodsname = #{goodsName}, spec = #{spec}, imgurl = #{imgUrl}, mainimgs = #{mainImgs}, sitecategory = #{siteCategory}, price = coalesce(#{price}, price), moq = #{moq}, unit = #{unit}, featured = coalesce(#{featured}, featured), publishstatus = coalesce(#{publishStatus}, publishstatus), sortnum = coalesce(#{sortNum}, sortnum), specsjson = #{specsJson}, optionsjson = #{optionsJson}, siteimgs = #{siteImgs}, sitevideos = #{siteVideos}, model3d = #{model3d}, model3d_marks = #{model3dMarks}, model3d_states = #{model3dStates}, mainvideo = #{mainVideo}, remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where sitecode = and goodscode = #{goodsCode}
update u_s_sitegoods set publishstatus = #{publishStatus}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where sitecode = and goodscode in #{code}
mapper.delete: delete from u_s_sitegoods where sitecode = and goodscode in #{code}
mapper.select: select shop_code, sitecode, goodscode, lang, title, subtitle, description, keywords, specsjson from u_s_sitegoods_lang where sitecode = and goodscode = #{goodsCode} order by lang
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_sitegoods_lang( shop_code, sitecode, goodscode, lang, title, subtitle, description, keywords, specsjson, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{siteCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{lang}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{description}, #{keywords}, #{specsJson}, sysdate() ) on duplicate key update title = values(title), subtitle = values(subtitle), description = values(description), keywords = values(keywords), specsjson = values(specsjson)
mapper.delete: delete from u_s_sitegoods_lang where sitecode = and goodscode in #{code}
mapper.update: update u_s_sitegoods set price = round(price * #{rate}, 4), updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where sitecode = and price > 0
